title: Minimum Cost to Move Between Indices
summary: Given strictly increasing nums, each index has a closest adjacent neighbor by value difference, choosing the lower index on ties. A move can go to any index for the absolute value difference, or to the closest neighbor for cost one. For each [start,end] query return the minimum total travel cost; directions can have different costs.
officialConstraints: Length 2..100000; values -10^9..10^9; 1..100000 queries with valid zero-based endpoints.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
